scope: Admin Backup & Disaster Recovery page and merchant navigation

requirements: Periodically tested DR, backup and failover plans
Manual invoice and pending transmission reconciliation
Statutory preservation, legal holds and written BIR storage-release confirmation

document_review.requirement: Backup procedure and DR plan with tested RTO and RPO
Accreditation supporting technical and continuity evidence

implementation.layout: Reference sections, existing shared admin navigation, navy/blue palette, skyline header, colored metric cards, policy cards, RPO/RTO rings, site table, workflow, actions and histories; responsive reflow retains readable text.
controls: Admin and super-admin access, existing privileged MFA boundary
Independent administrator review; no self approval
Persistent idempotent requests and optimistic review revisions
SHA-256 / size requirements for successful backup evidence
Source digest and environment matching for snapshot review
Measured RPO/RTO from timestamps; tabletop exercises excluded
Required integrity, keys, documents, sequence and pending-transmission checks
Stale evidence and failed retests invalidate current verified status
Draft targets require independent policy approval
Legal hold preservation and no purge or destructive endpoints
Audit records and generic admin operational notifications
Paginated complete history and scoped metadata JSON export
implementation.merchant_change: Removed separate Credit / Debit Notes navigation entry; document adjustment types remain in Invoices & Receipts.
implementation.evidence_scope: Readiness rollups use latest 2,000 submitted evidence records; export sections up to 100; complete history paginated.

browser: Synthetic request persisted across reload in isolated SQLite QA
Restore point list empty state and pagination verified
390px mobile document width equals viewport; no page overflow
Merchant sidebar verified without separate Credit / Debit Notes link

limitations: Infrastructure provider integration is not configured; no automated backup, restore or failover is performed by this page.
Actual encryption, immutability, offsite copies and tested recovery are unverified until supporting records are independently reviewed.
No production data changed, real backup/restore/failover test performed or real email sent during QA.
This implementation and source review do not establish BIR accreditation or approval.
